remarks: Spring has Sprung!! **Location, Location!!** Norwalk Sought After West Rocks/Cranbury Area! 3 Bedroom 1.5 Bath Ranch. One Level Living!! Light and Bright Living Room with Picture Window, Built-ins, and Wood Beams. Country Kitchen with Bay Window. Spacious Sun Filled Primary Bedroom. 2 Additional Bedrooms. Updated Full Bath with Designer Tile. Large Family Room with Wood Burning Fireplace, Artesian Stained-Glass Window Shutters, and an Updated Tile 1/2 Bath/Powder Room. Laundry/Mud Room. CENTRAL AIR. Garage. Like New Vinyl Siding. Newer Windows Throughout. Brick Patio. Expansive Fenced Rear Yard for Entertaining and the Pups. Mature Plantings and Landscaping. NEW 2024 ~ 50 Year Warrantee GAF Timberline ROOF. NEW 2025 ~ ROTH Double Wall Oil Tank. New Water Heater. 2015 Attic ~ Installation of Energy Saving R49 Insulation. This Property is in a Wonderful Location Surrounded by More Expensive Homes. Desired Updating and Design Ideas will be Well Worth the Effort!! Enjoy All that Norwalk has to offer! Less than 1 Hour from NYC. An Easy Commute by Road or Rail.
